mapper.select: SELECT CB.BN_ID, CB.BN_NAME, CB.BN_LINK, CB.BN_DESCRIPTION, CB.BN_WIDTH, CB.BN_HEIGHT, CB.BN_TOP, CB.BN_LEFT, AF.FILE_SAVE_PATH AS BNTHUMBPATH, AF.SAVE_FILE_NAME AS BNTHUMBNAME, AF.ORG_FILE_NAME AS BNORGTHUMBNAME, DATE_FORMAT(CB.BN_START_DATE,'%Y.%m.%d') AS BN_START_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(CB.BN_END_DATE,'%Y.%m.%d') AS BN_END_DATE FROM COM_BANNER CB LEFT JOIN ATCH_FILE AF ON AF.ATCH_FILE_IDX = CB.BN_THUMB WHERE CB.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND CB.BN_USE = '1' AND CB.BN_TYPE = #{bnType} AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(CB.BN_START_DATE) AND DATE(CB.BN_END_DATE)

SELECT BN_ID, BN_TYPE, BN_ORDER, BN_NAME, BN_DESCRIPTION, BN_LINK, BN_NEW_WIN, BN_START_DATE, BN_END_DATE, BN_USE, BN_EXT, BN_WIDTH, BN_HEIGHT, BN_TOP, BN_LEFT, BN_THUMB, BN_DISPLAY_TYPE, REG_DT, REG_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID FROM COM_BANNER WHERE DELETE_YN = 'N' AND BN_USE = '1' AND BN_TYPE = 'popup'
AND (BN_START_DATE IS NULL OR BN_START_DATE <= CURDATE()) AND (BN_END_DATE IS NULL OR BN_END_DATE >= CURDATE())
ORDER BY BN_ORDER ASC, REG_DT DESC
